expo_overview.name: University Expo Project
expo_overview.description: A comprehensive expo platform that connects students, companies, and visitors. The expo features student projects, company booths, service offerings, and interactive features like reels and feedback systems.
expo_overview.purpose: To showcase student innovation, facilitate industry connections, and provide a platform for companies to offer services and opportunities to students.

features.project_showcase: Students can submit their engineering or science projects for approval and exhibition at the expo. Projects include descriptions, photos, videos, and GitHub links.
features.company_participation: Companies can register as sponsors or service providers, get assigned booths, and create offerings for students.
features.booth_system: Interactive map system with various booth types (engineering, science, sponsor, service zones) with customizable layouts and locations.
features.feedback_system: Users can rate and comment on projects and companies to provide constructive feedback.
features.reels_feature: Short video clips that users can post to showcase quick highlights or demos.
features.user_roles: Four distinct roles - Visitors (general public), Students (project creators), Companies (sponsors/service providers), and Admins (expo management).

visitor.description: General public who can browse the expo, view projects, companies, and provide feedback.

student.description: University students who can create profiles, submit projects, and collaborate with other students.
capabilities: Create profile with CV and skills
Get assigned booths for approved projects

company.description: Organizations participating as sponsors or service providers.

admin.description: Expo management with full control over the platform.

project_types.engineering: Technical and engineering projects showcasing innovations, prototypes, and solutions.
project_types.science: Scientific research projects, experiments, and discoveries.

booth_zones.engineering: Zone designated for approved engineering student projects.
booth_zones.science: Zone designated for approved science student projects.
booth_zones.sponsor: Zone for sponsoring companies to showcase their brand.
booth_zones.service: Zone for companies offering services to students.

offering_status_flow.pending: Newly submitted offerings awaiting admin review.
offering_status_flow.approved: Offerings approved by admin and visible to users.
offering_status_flow.rejected: Offerings that did not meet expo criteria.

project_status_flow.pending: Newly submitted projects awaiting admin review.
project_status_flow.approved: Projects approved by admin, eligible for booth assignment and expo participation.
project_status_flow.rejected: Projects that did not meet expo criteria.
